connector.name: Brmarket MCP
connector.registryDescription: Brazilian marketplace search (ML, Shopee, AliExpress) + free import-tax calculator (x402)
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package brmarket-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the thomenz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: 0x private key of a DEDICATED wallet holding USDC on Base (pays per call). Paid tools return 402 without it.

env.name: SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: base58 or JSON-array secret key of a DEDICATED Solana wallet holding USDC (pays per call). Configure this and/or EVM_PRIVATE_KEY; the x402 layer settles on whichever rail the 402 advertises.

env.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
env.description: Optional Solana RPC override used to build the payment (e.g. a Helius URL).

env.name: BRMARKET_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of a brmarket Worker. Defaults to the hosted production API (https://brmarket.thomenz.me).
